#include <iostream>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

void solve(long long n, long long m, long long l, long long r) {
    long long cells = n * m;
    if (cells & 1) {
        cout << pow_mod(r - l + 1, cells) << endl;
        return;
    }
    long long even = r / 2 - (l - 1) / 2;
    long long odd = r - l + 1 - even;
    long long ans = (pow_mod(even + odd, cells) + pow_mod(even - odd, cells)) % MOD;
    ans = ans * 499122177LL % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    solve(n, m, l, r);
    return 0;
}
